title: ChatGPT vs Social Surveys: Probing Objective and Subjective Silicon Population

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM to generate simulated survey respondents and comparing the resulting distributions of income and educational attainment against actual US Census data to identify over- or under-representation.
Generating a sampling distribution of simulated respondents via repeated random sampling and comparing the racial demographic outputs to the 2020 US Census.

Measuring the demographic distribution of gender in simulated samples against Census data, and analyzing the model's simulated responses to World Values Survey (WVS) questions regarding traditional gender roles.
Comparing the LLM's simulated responses on World Values Survey (WVS) attitudinal questions regarding income inequality, meritocracy, and government responsibility to real human survey data.
Generating simulated survey respondents and comparing their resulting age distribution to the mean age from the 2020 American Community Survey (ACS).
